items.description: Adds the `@williamthorsen/systemd-service` package, whose `installService`, `readServiceState`, `restartService`, `uninstallService`, and `renderUnit` install, inspect, restart, remove, and render a service unit in `/etc/systemd/system` that systemd restarts 10 seconds after every exit without a start limit and whose stdout and stderr it appends to `stdout.log` and `stderr.log` in the spec's log directory. (#625)
